body: China's AutoFlight has staged what is claimed to be the world's first formation flight involving five unmanned eVTOL aircraft, sharing a video of the flight on November 5, 2026. The formation comprised a single five-ton V5000 and four two-ton V2000CG aircraft, all designed and built by AutoFlight. The company described the flight as a milestone in multi-aircraft coordination and unmanned logistics.

The five aircraft, trailing colored smoke trails, took off vertically and flew together for just over 45 minutes, reaching heights of up to 300 meters and covering a total distance of 66 kilometers. AutoFlight said coordinating aircraft of different types and payload classes to fly together demands a higher level of control, communication and coordination, and that the successful flight demonstrates its engineering strength in unmanned aerial logistics. The flight follows another five-aircraft formation flight on November 1, 2026, completed in mountainous terrain in winds of over 10 meters per second, and builds on a three-aircraft formation demonstration in May 2026.

The V2000CG CarryAll is an unmanned eVTOL capable of carrying up to two tons of cargo, and is the first ton-class eVTOL to receive all three airworthiness certificates from the Civil Aviation Administration of China: a Type Certificate, a Production Certificate and an Airworthiness Certificate. The V5000 is described by the company as the world's first and largest five-ton eVTOL. AutoFlight, which is also working on an 11-seat eVTOL, uses a Lift & Cruise configuration: its aircraft take off vertically on dedicated lift rotors, the front propellers tilt forward for transition to horizontal flight, and the rear propellers then push the aircraft forward so the fixed wings generate the lift needed for efficient cruising.
en.summary: AutoFlight has flown five unmanned eVTOLs in formation — one five-ton V5000 and four two-ton V2000CGs — for just over 45 minutes over 66 kilometers, in what is claimed to be a world first.
en.title: AutoFlight flies five unmanned eVTOLs in formation in claimed world first

body: 中國AutoFlight完成據稱全球首次由5架無人eVTOL組成的編隊飛行，並於2026年11月5日公布飛行影片。編隊由1架5噸級V5000與4架2噸級V2000CG組成，均由AutoFlight自行設計製造；公司稱這次飛行是多機協同與無人物流的重要里程碑。
5架飛行器拖著彩色煙霧垂直起飛，編隊飛行逾45分鐘，最高飛至300公尺，總航程66公里。AutoFlight表示，協調不同機型與載重級別的飛行器共同飛行，需要更高水準的控制、通訊與協同，這次成功飛行展現了公司在無人航空物流領域的工程實力。此前11月1日，5架eVTOL已在山區地形、風速逾每秒10公尺的惡劣天候下完成另一次編隊飛行；這次成果也延續了2026年5月的3機編隊展示。

V2000CG CarryAll為可載重達2噸的無人貨運eVTOL，是首款取得中國民航局全部3項適航證件的噸級eVTOL，包括型號合格證、生產許可證與適航證。V5000則被公司稱為全球首款、也是最大的5噸級eVTOL。AutoFlight另在研發11座eVTOL，其飛行器採「升力＋巡航」構型：以專用升力旋翼垂直起飛，前方螺旋槳向前傾轉進入平飛，再由後方螺旋槳推動，固定翼接手產生升力，實現高效水平飛行。
zh.summary: AutoFlight以1架5噸級V5000與4架2噸級V2000CG完成5架無人eVTOL編隊飛行，飛行逾45分鐘、航程66公里，據稱是全球首次。
zh.title: AutoFlight完成5架無人eVTOL編隊飛行，據稱全球首次
